Department of Retirement Systems DRS Draft Sole Source Contract 26-05
Description Of Opportunity
The Department of Retirement Systems (DRS) contemplates awarding a sole source contract to International Business Machines Corporation to provide IBM EntireX software products, including software licensing, maintenance, technical support, software updates, patches, and related product expertise required to support the Department of Retirement Systems' IBM EntireX environment, which enables integration between the agency's legacy business applications and modern web-based systems.
